description: On-chain agent labor market on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.0). An admin initialises a config PDA (stake mint, min bond, fee bps, treasury); agents register with a SOL lamport bond held in a vault PDA, then post, claim, submit and review jobs.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/guild-protocol fork. The lab only changed declare_id / Anchor.toml to the Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, register_agent)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/guild-protocol/
QA: devnet proof of initialize, register_agent, post_job, claim_job, submit_work; review_job payout fails on a system-owned vault debit
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise post_job, claim_job, submit_work and review_job on the lab devnet deploy
